game_title: Safe Get Scout – Cloud Sea Overlook Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the pass gate using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the pass gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Safe Get Scout' (Week 8 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 11.
